bot.start.greeting:
Hi, {name}! This is SameSync. People meet here through shared tastes and opinions, not photos.

Open the app to get started.
bot.help:
SameSync matches people by shared interests and opinions.

/start — open the app
/chats — my chats
/leave — end a chat
/reveal — exchange usernames (18+)
/help — this message

To write in a chat, reply to a message from it or just send text.
bot.game.turn: Your turn! {alias} has already guessed your answers. Now you guess theirs.
bot.game.results: Results are in! You and {alias} have both played — see who read the other better.

bot.game.reminder.one: {count} hour left to play. {alias} is waiting.
bot.game.reminder.other: {count} hours left to play. {alias} is waiting.

bot.game.expired: Time ran out for the game, so this match has closed ({alias}). New ones are on the way.
bot.game.expired.played: Your match didn't play in time, so it has closed ({alias}). New ones are on the way.
bot.unknown_command: There's no such command. See /help for the list.
bot.chat.none: There's no one to write to yet. A chat opens once the game results are ready: take a look in the app.
bot.chat.text_only: Only text can be sent for now. This message was not delivered.
bot.chat.too_long: That message is too long: the limit is {max} characters. It was not delivered.
bot.chat.too_fast: Too many messages in a row. This one was not delivered: wait a minute and send it again.
bot.chat.ended: This chat has ended. The message was not delivered.
bot.chat.ended.pick: This chat has ended. Send the message to another chat?
bot.chat.unavailable: You can't send messages right now.
bot.chat.u18_closed: Chat isn't available yet. The message was not delivered.
bot.chat.not_open: The chat opens once the game results are ready.
bot.chat.not_delivered: The message couldn't be delivered. Try again a little later.
bot.chat.picked: Sent to {alias}. Messages that aren't replies now go to this chat.
bot.chat.pick.lost: I can't see the original message. Please send it again.
bot.chat.duplicate: This message has already been sent.
bot.chat.edit: Edits aren't passed on: the other person sees the message as it was first sent. Send a new one if you need to.

bot.chat.reminder.one: {count} hour left to send the first message ({alias}). After that this match closes.
bot.chat.reminder.other: {count} hours left to send the first message ({alias}). After that this match closes.

bot.chat.expired: The chat didn't start, so this match has closed ({alias}). New ones are on the way.
bot.chats.list: Your chats. Tap one, and messages that aren't replies will go to it:
bot.leave.pick: Which chat do you want to end?
bot.leave.confirm: End this chat ({alias})? It can't be brought back.
bot.reveal.none: You can exchange usernames in an open chat, and there isn't one yet.
bot.reveal.pick: Who do you want to exchange usernames with?
bot.reveal.ask: Exchange Telegram usernames ({alias})? They are revealed only if both sides agree.
bot.reveal.waiting: Your consent is recorded. The usernames are revealed once the other person agrees too ({alias}).
bot.reveal.request: {alias} suggests exchanging Telegram usernames. They are revealed only if both sides agree.
bot.reveal.declined: OK, the usernames stay hidden. Send /reveal if you change your mind.
bot.reveal.username_needed: You don't have a Telegram username yet, so there's nothing to exchange. Set one in Telegram's settings and send /reveal again: your consent is saved.
bot.reveal.other_username_missing: It didn't work yet: the other person has no Telegram username right now ({alias}). Try again later with /reveal.
bot.reveal.on_the_way: Both sides agreed. The username is on its way ({alias}).
